items.caption: A seal-style form of 書, shown as a modern redraw of the Shuowen form.
items.alt: Black seal-style 書 graph with a brush-like upper structure above a lower enclosure.
items.selection_reason: This identified form helps illustrate the traditional graph discussed in the entry. Its seal-style label does not establish a date or a sequence of development.

items.caption: A bronze-style redraw of 書; the form’s period is unspecified.
items.alt: Black bronze-style 書 graph with a layered upper section and a rounded lower form.
items.selection_reason: It provides a distinct labeled graphic for comparison with the seal-style form, but does not establish chronology or graphic succession.

limitations.text: Both images are modern redraws rather than photographs of dated artifacts. The seal-style and bronze-style labels do not establish the forms’ dates, their order, or the earliest attestation of 書.
